device: Pixel 6 Pro, 1440x3120 portrait, coordinates in screen pixels
video: 60 fps constant frame rate; first gesture DOWN placed at 1.000 s; last frame held so the opened app shows for ~2 s
gesture: Quick launch ON: press folder, ~0.32 s hold, slide onto Clock over ~0.43 s (eased, slight arc), ~0.18 s rest, lift. Moves were injected with adb `input motionevent` about every 30-40 ms (the fastest the allowed adb route goes), not every 16 ms; interpolate between points for the finger.
alignment: Times come from device timestamps of each injection, shifted so the DOWN sits one frame before the first visible reaction on screen. Expect +/-1 frame.
